variants.name: self_trained_frozen
variants.status: planned; embeddings and LM not trained

variants.name: public_pretrained_frozen
variants.status: planned; vectors not acquired; LM not trained

self_embedding_training.data: training paragraphs only; no cross-paragraph pairs
self_embedding_training.boundaries: exclude pad/bos/eos; allow training tokens mapped to unk
self_embedding_training.vector_choice: input/center embedding; output/context table is not transferred

public_embeddings.name: GloVe 6B 100d
public_embeddings.source_corpus: Wikipedia 2014 and Gigaword 5; external training data

alignment.lookup: exact match against existing lowercase vocabulary tokens
alignment.missing_and_special_rows: same seeded N(0,1) fallback matrix in both frozen variants; pad row zero
alignment.freeze: entire input table, including missing and special rows
alignment.coverage: report matched ordinary vocabulary types and train/validation/test token occurrence coverage; special tokens excluded

training_control: same non-embedding initialization, fresh seeded loaders, Adam/budget/validation selection; no trained Part I recurrent or output weights transferred
evaluation: same CE/PPL, curves, shared generation config; report stability with single-seed limitation
interpretation: source and trainability vary together; public embeddings add external data; not an isolated data-source effect
